name: Gmail
author: EdgeSidekick
description: 按 Gmail 搜索语法查找邮件、阅读邮件与会话、查看标签，并能起草或发送邮件（发送前会请你确认）。

credentials.name: client_id
credentials.label: OAuth Client ID
credentials.help: Google Cloud 控制台 → API 和服务 → 凭据 → 创建 OAuth 客户端 ID，应用类型选「桌面应用」，并启用 Gmail API。

credentials.name: refresh_token
credentials.label: Refresh token
credentials.help: 填好 Client ID/Secret 后点「用 Google 授权」自动获取；也可以从 OAuth Playground 手动粘贴。

tools.name: search_messages
tools.label: 搜索邮件
tools.description: Search the mailbox with Gmail search syntax, e.g. 'is:unread newer_than:2d', 'from:alice@example.com has:attachment', 'subject:invoice after:2026/01/01'. Returns id, thread id, from, to, subject, date and snippet.

query.description: Gmail search query (empty = latest inbox mail)

tools.name: read_message
tools.label: 阅读邮件
tools.description: Read one message: headers, plain-text body (HTML converted to text) and attachment names.

tools.name: read_thread
tools.label: 阅读会话
tools.description: Read a whole conversation thread in order, with each message's sender, date and body.

tools.name: list_labels
tools.label: 标签列表
tools.description: List mailbox labels with unread counts.

tools.name: create_draft
tools.label: 起草邮件
tools.description: Create a draft (not sent). Pass reply_to_id to draft a reply in that message's thread.

tools.name: send_message
tools.label: 发送邮件
tools.description: Send an email immediately. Only call after the user explicitly confirmed recipients, subject and body.
